dialogue.name: CHROMATIC
dialogue.text: So... it's a bit of a fixer-upper-

dialogue.name: CHROMATIC
dialogue.text: - but I think she can look very cute by the time I'm done with her.

dialogue.name: FLAT
dialogue.text: Oh no, please, no more moving boxes, I think I'll go mad.

dialogue.name: MAJOR
dialogue.text: Nonsense Flat, we'll need you on the frontlines with your steady beats!

dialogue.name: MAJOR
dialogue.text: I'll ask if any of the other lifters would be willing to help out.

dialogue.name: TRILL
dialogue.text: Are we sure that Temperance Metals won't find this place?

dialogue.name: MAJOR
dialogue.text: Well, if I'm remembering things correctly, this was one of the buildings in our backlog.

dialogue.name: MAJOR
dialogue.text: I don't think anyone will find this place anytime soon.

dialogue.name: CHROMATIC
dialogue.text: Oh, I can already picture it! We can have a little meeting table over there, and a repair corner by the computer...

dialogue.name: CHROMATIC
dialogue.text: I'll have to find a good spot for a record player.

dialogue.name: FLAT
dialogue.text: This place is going to be lost in a sea of glitter and stickers.

dialogue.name: MAJOR
dialogue.text: I trust that Chromatic will uphold professionalism during her redecorating.

dialogue.name: CHROMATIC
dialogue.text: How much of the screen do you need to see in order for it to be functional?

dialogue.name: TRILL
dialogue.text: ... I'll choose to believe you, Major.
